just-frame-2026.name: JUST FRAME 2026
just-frame-2026.location: Salmón 5204, Sábalo Country, 82100 Mazatlán, Sin., Mexico
just-frame-2026.venueName: Colegio de Ingenieros Civiles de Mazatlán
just-frame-2026.description:
Celebrating its fourth annual edition in the coastal hub of Mazatlán, JUST FRAME 2026 stands as an established gathering point for northwest Mexico's competitive fighting game scene. Since its 2023 debut, the grassroots open has grown into an essential stop on the regional calendar, building upon the prior edition that welcomed 77 attendees across its tournament floor. Highlighting the weekend's competitive program, Street Fighter 6 serves as the marquee battleground for competitors testing their mettle on the regional stage.

Brackets for Street Fighter 6 bring together elite regional talent vying for supremacy in Mexico's competitive landscape. Double-elimination pool play demands sharp execution and composure under pressure, offering contenders crucial circuit prestige and proving ground momentum.

Tournament Lineup

Beyond the headline clashes on the Capcom side, the venue hosts a diverse roster of competitive brackets. Sanctioned circuit stakes elevate Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves and The King of Fighters XV through SNK World Championship qualification pathways. Meanwhile, tournament play in 2XKO and MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls rounds out the competitive schedule alongside dedicated open stations for casual matches and off-bracket challenges.

first-attack-2026-2.name: First Attack 2026
first-attack-2026-2.location: 100 Convention Blvd, San Juan, 00907, Puerto Rico
first-attack-2026-2.description:
Established in 2013 as a grassroots gathering before expanding into the Caribbean's premier fighting game destination, First Attack 2026 marks over a decade of international competition in San Juan. Known throughout the fighting game community as the quintessential vacation tournament, the festival blends tropical travel with world-class tournament play, building on a prior edition that drew 536 attendees. At the center of the festival floor, Street Fighter 6 headlines the weekend as the marquee battleground.

The Street Fighter 6 bracket brings together international challengers and top Caribbean talent in an open double-elimination format. With pool play narrowing into a cutthroat Top 8 showcase, competitors battle through high-pressure sets where split-second reads dictate bracket survival. Every match carries serious weight, offering contenders vital proving-ground momentum and regional dominance.

Convention Floor & Tournament Lineup

Beyond the marquee Capcom action, the event spans more than twenty competitive titles across three full days. Sanctioned circuit designations bring high stakes to TEKKEN 8 on the TEKKEN World Tour, while Guilty Gear: Strive and MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls feature as Arc World Tour stops. The lineup also highlights a designated 2XKO Challenger bracket alongside community competitions in Super Smash Bros. Ultimate, Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves, and classic retro fighters.

Activities & Registration

Attendees can explore an active vendor floor and artist alley, participate in cosplay contests, or enter trading card tournaments covering Pokémon, Yu-Gi-Oh, and One Piece. Competitors secure tournament entry directly through start.gg, while spectator passes and weekend badges are handled through the event's ticketing partner.

evo-france-2026.name: Evo France 2026
evo-france-2026.description:
Returning to the French Riviera for its second European edition, Evo France 2026 marks the international expansion of the world's most storied fighting game championship series. The open festival builds upon an inaugural gathering that welcomed 3,498 attendees from over ninety countries to Nice, establishing a premier continental battleground. Across three days of intense open-bracket play, Street Fighter 6 commands center stage as the headline spectacle of the weekend.

Sanctioned as a premier stop on the Capcom Pro Tour, the Street Fighter 6 bracket carries high competitive weight. Contenders fight through grueling double-elimination pools where early-round volatility tests tournament composure at every turn. Beyond substantial prize payouts, the tournament champion secures an automatic qualification spot for Capcom Cup, making bracket survival crucial for global contenders seeking direct passage to the world championship stage.

Convention Floor & Tournament Lineup

Beyond the premier Capcom competition, the festival features official tournament brackets across seven additional titles. Open competition spans TEKKEN 8, 2XKO, MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls, Guilty Gear: Strive, Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves, Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising, and Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game. Attendees can explore publisher exhibition booths showcasing upcoming content, an active artist alley, and open BYOC areas hosting community-run side tournaments alongside a dedicated free-play arcade.

Venue Logistics & Registration

Tournament registration and spectator ticketing operate through start.gg, with badge pickup opening the day before competitive play begins. General weekend badges grant full access to show-floor attractions, side brackets, and main stage viewing across Friday and Saturday, while Sunday championship finals feature reserved arena seating.

roundhouse-2026.name: Roundhouse 2026
roundhouse-2026.description:
Marking its sixth annual edition as an anchor of the Midwest fighting game calendar, Roundhouse 2026 brings regional and national competitors together under the banner of Low Kick Esports. The gathering continues a steady trajectory of growth following a 2025 edition that drew 570 attendees to the Chicago suburbs. Across a packed multi-day program, Street Fighter 6 commands premier positioning as the headline competitive attraction.

The marquee Street Fighter 6 open tournament delivers high stakes backed by a boosted prize purse with an injected pot bonus. In addition to standard double-elimination bracket play, the title serves as the battleground for the annual MIDBEST 3v3 state exhibition series, where qualified trios from across the region face off for territorial pride following a Friday Last Chance Qualifier.

Tournament Lineup

Beyond headline Capcom competition, the event hosts official qualifying stops for the SNK World Championship across Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves, The King of Fighters XV, and Samurai Shodown. Dedicated brackets with pot bonuses also spotlight TEKKEN 8 and MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls, running alongside competitions in 2XKO, Guilty Gear: Strive, and retro staples including Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike.

Convention Features & Community House

Attendees have access to an artist alley and vendor market, custom trivia contests, and the Community House ballroom dedicated to casual setups and grassroots side games. Friday programming showcases team play through Roundhouse TAG 2v2 tournaments, leading into weekend main-stage finals spotlighted inside the custom Roundhouse Ring.

socal-knockout-2026.name: SoCal Knockout 2026
socal-knockout-2026.description:
SoCal Knockout 2026 marks the inaugural edition of a collaborative grassroots regional, bringing Northern and Southern California organizing communities together for a dedicated weekend of open-bracket competition. Set at the Riverside Game Lab, the debut gathering establishes a unified proving ground for West Coast talent, centering Street Fighter 6 as the anchor of the inter-regional showdown.

The tournament provides crucial regional seeding weight and head-to-head prestige for competitors looking to solidify their standing across the West Coast scene. Players navigate a standard double-elimination structure built to test character mastery and matchup depth in a high-stakes bracket environment.

Additional Tournament Brackets

Beyond the primary bracket, the weekend hosts an extensive lineup of competitive fighting games, including TEKKEN 8, Guilty Gear -Strive-, Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising, and legacy anime brackets such as BlazBlue: Central Fiction.

drowning-pools-2026.name: Drowning Pools 2026
drowning-pools-2026.location: Metropolitan Cathedral, Brownlow Hill, Liverpool L3 5TQ, UK
drowning-pools-2026.description:
Drowning Pools 2026 brings the Merseyside FGC community together for a day of fighting game competition in Liverpool, with Street Fighter 6 featured alongside a wider multi-game lineup.

Registration and the latest information are available on the official Start.gg event page.
